display.label: IAM Project Binding
display.description: Grants one project-level IAM role to one principal. Create-only and sensitive: existing project IAM policy is never adopted

globals.label: Project ID
globals.description: GCP Project ID on which the IAM role is granted.

resource.key_description: Unique Terraform map key for this grant. Use the principal-role convention, for example app-sa-storage-admin.

sections.label: Principal
sections.description: Exactly one principal receives this grant. Every field here is part of the grant's identity and cannot be edited afterwards; revoke the binding and request a new one instead.

fields.label: Binding ID
fields.description: Unique key for this grant. Use the principal-role convention, for example app-sa-storage-admin.

validation.pattern_error: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.

fields.label: Service account
fields.description: Service account that receives the role. The serviceAccount: prefix is added automatically.

fields.label: User email
fields.description: User that receives the role. The user: prefix is added automatically.

fields.label: Principal set address
fields.description: Principal set that receives the role. The principalSet:// prefix is added automatically.

sections.label: Project-Level Role
sections.description: One project-level IAM role. Request an additional binding for each additional role.

fields.label: Project Role
fields.description: IAM role granted at the project level, for example roles/viewer or roles/storage.objectAdmin.
